connector.name: e2a - email for AI agents by e2a.dev
connector.registryDescription: Authenticated email gateway for AI agents - per-agent inboxes, HITL approval, SPF/DKIM verified.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.e2a.dev over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace dev.e2a, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: OAuth 2.1 is the recommended connection (add the connector and authorize — no key to paste; auto-discovered via /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource). For programmatic / self-host use, a Bearer e2a API key (e2a_acct_… or e2a_agt_…) is also accepted.
